memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia, vitamin D deficiency, and obesity.
She reports fatigue, mild dyspnoea on exertion, and occasional pica. Menstrual cycles are regular. On exam she appears pale, BMI 32 kg/m2, no lymphadenopathy, lungs clear. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking status: never. Hb 9.8 g/dL, ferritin 12 ng/mL, vitamin D 14 ng/mL. Plan: start iron replacement, vitamin D loading, lifestyle advice.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg oral once daily
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU oral once weekly for 8 weeks
Orlistat 120 mg oral with each main meal

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia improving, vitamin D replete, obesity unchanged.
She feels less fatigued, no pica. Menstrual bleeding normal. Exam: pallor mild, BMI 31.8. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking: never. Hb 11.4 g/dL, ferritin 45 ng/mL, vitamin D 32 ng/mL. Continue iron, switch vitamin D to maintenance, reinforce diet and activity.

Orlistat 120 mg oral with each main meal

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia resolved, vitamin D sufficient, obesity persisting.
She reports normal energy, no cravings. Menstrual flow regular. Exam: no pallor, BMI 31.5. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking: never. Hb 12.8 g/dL, ferritin 78 ng/mL, vitamin D 38 ng/mL. Stop iron, continue vitamin D maintenance, intensify weight‑management plan.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity unchanged, nutritional deficiencies corrected.
She notes difficulty losing weight despite diet, occasional joint discomfort. Exam: BMI 31.2, blood pressure 118/72, lungs clear. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking: never. Labs: Hb 13.0 g/dL, ferritin 85 ng/mL, vitamin D 36 ng/mL, glucose 94, HbA1c 5.4%. Continue orlistat, add structured exercise referral.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg oral with each main meal (continue)
Cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral once daily (continue)

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Weight stable, nutritional markers good.
She reports modest weight loss of 1.5 kg, improved energy, no GI side‑effects from orlistat. Exam: BMI 30.8, abdomen soft, no hepatomegaly. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking: never. Hb 13.2 g/dL, ferritin 90 ng/mL, vitamin D 35 ng/mL, fasting glucose 92, HbA1c 5.3%. Continue current regimen, reinforce activity.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Mild weight reduction maintained, labs unchanged.
She notes occasional knee discomfort on stairs, otherwise well. Exam: BMI 30.5, joints non‑tender, lungs clear. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking: never. Hb 13.1 g/dL, ferritin 88 ng/mL, vitamin D 34 ng/mL, glucose 93, HbA1c 5.4%. Maintain orlistat, vitamin D, advise low‑impact exercise.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Overall stable: anemia and vitamin D corrected, obesity modestly improved.
She reports sustained 3 kg loss from baseline, regular menses, no fatigue. Exam: BMI 30.0, no pallor, lungs clear. Spirometry not indicated. Smoking: never. Hb 13.0 g/dL, ferritin 85 ng/mL, vitamin D 33 ng/mL, fasting glucose 91, HbA1c 5.3%. Continue current plan, review in 3 months.
